item.title: REA-Lotus Bank ₦100bn MoU hits first milestone | Energy Times
item.description: The funding, backed by the Distributed Access through Renewable Energy Scale-up (DARES) Program’s Performance-Based Grant (PBG) framework, marks the first major drawdown from the Lotus Bank facility.

item.title: Adelabu assures Nigerians of improved power supply in two weeks | Energy Times
item.description: The Minister of Power, Adebayo Adelabu, has formally apologised to Nigerians over the recent nationwide electricity outages, describing the disruptions as temporary and assuring citizens that power supply will improve within two weeks.

item.title: NUPRC, SeaSeis seal 3D seismic, gravity data deal | Energy Times
item.description: The three-year agreement also empowers the partnership to issue data-use licences, with revenues to be shared between the company and the Commission.

item.title: 2025 MDAs Scorecard: REA tops Power Sector in integrity, compliance, ethics -ICPC | Energy Times
item.description: The ranking, released in a report titled: ‘Ethic and Integrity Compliance Scorecard of MDAs of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 2025’, underscores the agency’s strong adherence to ethical standards, transparency, and accountability, as well as the robustness of its governance structures, operational systems, and compliance culture over the past two years.

item.title: IBEDC announces Deolu Ijose as new MD/CEO | Energy Times
item.description: His appointment follows the recent reconstitution of the Company’s Board of Directors. Mr. Ijose succeeds Engr. Francis Agoha, FNSE.

item.title: Esso Conducts Groundbreaking Ceremony for Permanent Shore Base Facility at LADOL | Energy Times
item.description: The ceremony, held at LADOL, Apapa Port, Lagos, was attended by key government stakeholders, including senior officials of the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB), and the National Upstream Petroleum Investment Management Services (NUIMS), alongside industry partners.

item.title: Workers’ Group, WoPU celebrates President Tinubu on birthday | Energy Times
item.description: The group, in a statement signed by its National Coordinator-General, Comrade Prince Akporeha Williams, described President Tinubu as a statesman, reformer, and visionary leader whose political journey continues to shape the direction of the nation.

item.title: Why Shore Base Infrastructure Is Critical to Nigeria’s Deep‑Offshore Future | Energy Times
item.description: When the Lagos Deep Offshore Logistics Base (LADOL) and ExxonMobil affiliate, Esso Exploration and Production Nigeria Limited (EEPNL), broke ground on a permanent Shore Base facility on March 26, 2026, the significance went far beyond a ceremonial turning the sod.

item.title: Afreximbank supports Dangote Refinery with $2.5bn commitment | Energy Times
item.description: The five-year facility, arranged alongside Access Bank as co-Mandated Lead Arrangers, is designed to consolidate existing debt, optimize the refinery’s capital structure and align its financing with current operational realities. The transaction marks a significant milestone for the Dangote Refinery, Africa’s largest refining and petrochemical complex with a capacity of 650,000 barrels per day.

item.title: Nigeria’s oil, condensate reserves hit 37.01bn barrels, gas to last 85 years — NUPRC | Energy Times
item.description: In a statement personally signed by the Commission Chief Executive, Mrs. Oritsemeyiwa Eyesan, the Commission announced the figures as Nigeria’s official national petroleum reserves position for 2026.
